text:
Sofia: hey 👋 I'm Sofia — starting as AE on Monday. Quick access q's: HubSpot seat, Gong access, Dialpad softphone for demo calls, and the demo laptop image. Also where do I find the latest sales playbooks and the 1-pager collateral? who should I ping for each? thx!
Onboarding Bot: welcome @Sofia! :tada: New hire checklist created: https://redwood.in/onboard/Sofia — please complete the provisioning form there. You'll be auto-added to #sales-onboarding and given default seats once approved.
Derek (sales-ops): hey @Sofia welcome! I'll take HubSpot + Gong. Please complete the provisioning form (link above) and I'll queue seats. For Dialpad softphone we need your preferred caller ID. If you need a specific demo number or caller ID, note it in the "phone config" field. Internal provisioning link: https://internal.redwood/provision (requires SSO).
Alex (IT): I can handle the demo laptop image. Do you want mac or linux? We have a standard AE image (mac-arm and ubuntu-22). Once you confirm I'll schedule an image build. VPN install for mac/linux (run after image):
```\ncurl -sSf https://dl.redwood/vpn-install.sh | sudo bash\n```
Maria (AE): hi @Sofia :wave: i'll drop you the playbook folder and sample call scripts. I keep a 'first-week call script' and handoff checklist in Drive. Ping me if you want shadowing this week.
Sofia: submitted the provisioning form just now — thank you! For caller ID please set it to "Redwood - Sofia" for demos.
Derek (sales-ops): got it — HubSpot seat queued (typical turnaround 1-2 biz days), Gong invite sent, Dialpad request logged. I'll follow up here if any approvals are needed. :thumbsup: 
Alex (IT): Image build started — ETA ~4 hours for mac-arm. You'll get an email with remote access creds when it's ready.
Sofia: awesome, appreciate it. one last thing — who handles Loom/licensing for recorded demos?
Lina (tools): hey @Sofia, Lina here — I manage Loom and call recording licenses. I'll add you to Loom and to the demo templates folder: https://drive.redwood/demo-templates. Expect invites in ~30 min.
Maria (AE): sample opener you can copy into notes: "Hi, I'm Sofia from Redwood Inference — quick 20 min to show the flow?" For handoff: confirm account + SLO needs, then route to Solutions for pricing.
Sofia: perfect. Thanks everyone! excited to join. :party-parrot:
